newsitem.title: USA: Duramed nausea tablets approved by FDA.
newsitem.headline: Duramed nausea tablets approved by FDA.

text.p: Duramed Pharmaceuticals Inc said Friday it had received Food and Drug Administration authorization to market anti-nausea prochlorperazine tablets in five-mg and 10-mg strengths.
The company said the FDA granted its tablets a therapeutic equivalency rating of AB, designating them as a generic version of compazine tablets made by SmithKline Beecham Plc.
A company spokeswoman said three other companies besides Duramed make and market generic compazine tablets.
Duramed said it expects to begin shipping the product in the third quarter.

It said it expects several more products to be cleared by the FDA during 1997 and 1998. It said it has 10 more abbreviated new drug applications pending with the agency, and it expects to file more than a dozen more later this year.
